title: Navigate transport and directions
lessons:
# Chapter 7 — Navigate transport and directions

## Goals and prerequisites
Use the time, number, and question skills from Chapters 3 and 5 to find a route, buy a ticket, and understand a change or delay. You will practise common location and movement phrases, then combine them in connected directions. If you can already ask où and quand, apply those questions to stations, platforms, and routes.

## Location and movement
Common location prepositions include `à` (at/to), `dans` (in/inside), `sur` (on), `sous` (under), `devant` (in front of), `derrière` (behind), `près de` (near), `en face de` (opposite), and `à côté de` (next to). Before masculine singular nouns, `à + le` becomes `au` and `de + le` becomes `du`: `au guichet`, `près du métro`. `À la` and `de la` remain separate; before a vowel, `à l'` and `de l'` are used.

Movement chunks are useful whole units: `aller à pied` (go on foot), `prendre le bus` (take the bus), `changer de ligne` (change lines), `descendre à la prochaine station` (get off at the next station), and `traverser la rue` (cross the street). Use `à` with a city and learn country prepositions with the place. Transport methods often use `en` (`en bus`, `en train`) but `à pied` and `à vélo` are fixed chunks.

## Give and follow directions
Imperatives give instructions: `Tournez à droite` (turn right), `Continuez tout droit` (continue straight), `Traversez au feu` (cross at the light). Polite instructions often use **vous** forms. Sequence steps with `d'abord`, `puis`, `ensuite`, `enfin`. Add landmarks and distance: `après le pont` (after the bridge), `à deux rues d'ici` (two streets from here), `jusqu'au coin` (as far as the corner). Confirm which side or direction: `C'est à gauche ou à droite ?`

## Public transport information
A route may include a line, direction, platform, transfer, and time. `La ligne 2 en direction du centre` means line 2 toward downtown; `correspondance` is a connection/transfer. `quai` means platform for trains; a bus may use `arrêt` (stop). Listen for negation and corrections: `Le train ne s'arrête pas à Laval aujourd'hui` means the train does not stop at Laval today. Catch the alternative action, not only the problem. Keep a number/time note and confirm it out loud if uncertain.

## Skills and retrieval
Listening tasks use connected announcements rather than isolated direction words. Reading tasks ask you to combine two route details. Speak a clear route in steps, and ask one confirmation question. Writing practice can be a short transit update that includes the service, change, and alternative. Do not treat a browser voice as authentic station audio.

Before the first reveal: Give a polite French direction to continue straight and turn left; then say “change lines” and “next to” in French.

:::answer
`Continuez tout droit, puis tournez à gauche` = Continue straight, then turn left. `Changer de ligne` = change lines. `À côté de` = next to.
:::

Before the second reveal: Ask where the stop is, say that the train does not stop here, and name the French word for a transfer.

:::answer
`Où est l'arrêt ?` asks where the stop is. `Le train ne s'arrête pas ici` means the train does not stop here. A transfer/connection is `une correspondance`.
:::

## Self-check and spaced review
Can you explain a two-step walking route? Can you hear a platform and departure time in an announcement? Can you describe the alternative when service is interrupted? Review 12 items the next day, after three days, and one week later. Sketch a tiny route from memory, then describe it in French; later listen to the model and compare sequence and landmarks.

bank.fr: Où se trouve l'arrêt de bus ?
bank.en: Where is the bus stop?
bank.prompt: Ask where a bus stop is.

bank.fr: L'arrêt est devant la bibliothèque.
bank.en: The stop is in front of the library.

bank.fr: La station de métro est sous la place.
bank.en: The subway station is under the square.

bank.fr: Le quai se trouve à gauche du guichet.
bank.en: The platform is to the left of the ticket window.
bank.cue: À gauche du means to the left of.

bank.fr: La sortie est en face de la pharmacie.
bank.en: The exit is opposite the pharmacy.
bank.prompt: Describe a landmark across from the exit.

bank.fr: Le café est à côté de la station.
bank.en: The café is next to the station.
bank.cue: À côté de means next to.

bank.fr: Le taxi attend derrière l'hôtel.
bank.en: The taxi is waiting behind the hotel.

bank.fr: Le vélo est attaché au poteau.
bank.en: The bicycle is locked to the post.
bank.prompt: Understand where the bicycle is secured.
bank.cue: Attaché au means attached to the.

bank.fr: Nous allons à pied jusqu'au parc.
bank.en: We're walking to the park.

bank.fr: Prenez la ligne verte en direction du nord.
bank.en: Take the green line heading north.
bank.cue: En direction de means heading toward.

bank.fr: Changez à la station centrale.
bank.en: Change at Central Station.

bank.fr: La ligne rouge est interrompue entre les deux stations.
bank.en: The red line is interrupted between the two stations.

bank.fr: Un autobus de remplacement part toutes les dix minutes.
bank.en: A replacement bus leaves every ten minutes.
bank.prompt: Hear how often the shuttle leaves.
bank.cue: Toutes les dix minutes means every ten minutes.

bank.fr: Le prochain train arrive dans cinq minutes.
bank.en: The next train arrives in five minutes.
bank.prompt: Say how soon the train arrives.

bank.fr: Le train pour Ottawa part du quai quatre.
bank.en: The train to Ottawa leaves from platform four.
bank.cue: Quai quatre is the platform number.

bank.fr: Le bus numéro douze s'arrête ici.
bank.en: Bus number twelve stops here.

bank.fr: Descendez à la prochaine station.
bank.en: Get off at the next station.

bank.fr: Nous descendons à la station du marché.
bank.en: We get off at Market Station.
bank.prompt: Name the stop where you get off.
bank.cue: À la station names the stop.

bank.fr: La station suivante est Université.
bank.en: The next station is University.

bank.fr: Le métro ne s'arrête pas à cette station.
bank.en: The subway doesn't stop at this station.

bank.fr: Prenez la sortie B pour le centre-ville.
bank.en: Take exit B for downtown.
bank.cue: Pour le centre-ville gives the destination.

bank.fr: La sortie A est fermée aujourd'hui.
bank.en: Exit A is closed today.
bank.prompt: Hear which exit cannot be used.

bank.fr: Suivez les panneaux vers la gare.
bank.en: Follow the signs toward the station.

bank.fr: Continuez tout droit pendant deux rues.
bank.en: Continue straight for two blocks.

bank.fr: Tournez à droite après le pont.
bank.en: Turn right after the bridge.
bank.cue: Après le pont fixes the turn location.

bank.fr: Tournez à gauche au prochain feu.
bank.en: Turn left at the next traffic light.
bank.cue: Au prochain feu means at the next light.

bank.fr: Traversez la rue au passage piéton.
bank.en: Cross the street at the crosswalk.

bank.fr: Le passage piéton est près de l'école.
bank.en: The crosswalk is near the school.

bank.fr: Attendez le feu vert avant de traverser.
bank.en: Wait for the green light before crossing.

bank.fr: Le feu passe au rouge.
bank.en: The light turns red.
bank.cue: Passe au rouge means turns red.

bank.fr: Marchez jusqu'au coin de la rue.
bank.en: Walk as far as the corner.
bank.cue: Jusqu'au means up to/as far as.

bank.fr: La banque est au coin de la rue King.
bank.en: The bank is at the corner of King Street.
bank.cue: Au coin de means at the corner of.

bank.fr: Continuez jusqu'à la grande place.
bank.en: Continue as far as the large square.

bank.fr: La rue piétonne commence après le restaurant.
bank.en: The pedestrian street begins after the restaurant.

bank.fr: Le stationnement est derrière le bâtiment.
bank.en: Parking is behind the building.

bank.fr: L'entrée du stationnement est sur la rue nord.
bank.en: The parking entrance is on North Street.
bank.cue: Sur la rue identifies the street.

bank.fr: Le stationnement coûte quatre dollars par heure.
bank.en: Parking costs four dollars per hour.

bank.fr: Est-ce qu'il y a un stationnement gratuit ?
bank.en: Is there free parking?

bank.fr: Il y a un stationnement public près du musée.
bank.en: There is a public parking lot near the museum.
bank.prompt: Tell someone where public parking is.

bank.fr: La place est réservée aux autobus.
bank.en: The space is reserved for buses.

bank.fr: Je cherche la billetterie de la gare.
bank.en: I'm looking for the station ticket office.

bank.fr: La billetterie est au rez-de-chaussée.
bank.en: The ticket office is on the ground floor.

bank.fr: Vous pouvez acheter un billet à la machine.
bank.en: You can buy a ticket at the machine.
bank.prompt: Hear how to purchase a ticket.
bank.cue: À la machine gives the place.

bank.fr: Je voudrais un aller simple pour Québec.
bank.en: I would like a one-way ticket to Quebec City.

bank.fr: Un aller-retour pour deux adultes, s'il vous plaît.
bank.en: A return ticket for two adults, please.

bank.fr: Le billet est valable jusqu'à dimanche soir.
bank.en: The ticket is valid until Sunday evening.

bank.fr: Le tarif réduit est réservé aux étudiants.
bank.en: The reduced fare is reserved for students.
bank.prompt: Identify who qualifies for the fare.

bank.fr: Avez-vous une carte de transport ?
bank.en: Do you have a transit pass?
bank.cue: Carte de transport is a transit pass.

bank.fr: Ma carte ne fonctionne plus.
bank.en: My card no longer works.

bank.fr: Rechargez votre carte au guichet.
bank.en: Reload your card at the ticket counter.

bank.fr: Le valideur est près de l'escalier.
bank.en: The ticket validator is near the stairs.
bank.cue: Valideur is the machine that validates tickets.

bank.fr: Validez votre billet avant de monter.
bank.en: Validate your ticket before boarding.
bank.cue: Avant de monter means before boarding.

bank.fr: Le billet est valable pour une heure.
bank.en: The ticket is valid for one hour.
bank.prompt: Hear how long the ticket is valid.

bank.fr: Nous avons raté le dernier autobus.
bank.en: We missed the last bus.
bank.prompt: Explain why the group needs another route.

bank.fr: Le prochain autobus passe dans vingt minutes.
bank.en: The next bus comes in twenty minutes.

bank.fr: Le bus est bloqué dans la circulation.
bank.en: The bus is stuck in traffic.
bank.prompt: Understand the source of the delay.

bank.fr: Un accident ralentit la circulation près du pont.
bank.en: An accident is slowing traffic near the bridge.

bank.fr: Le service reprend à partir de midi.
bank.en: Service resumes from noon.
bank.cue: À partir de means starting from.

bank.fr: La navette part toutes les quinze minutes.
bank.en: The shuttle leaves every fifteen minutes.

bank.fr: La navette vous conduit à l'aéroport.
bank.en: The shuttle takes you to the airport.
bank.cue: Conduire quelqu'un à means take someone to.

bank.fr: L'aéroport se trouve à trente kilomètres du centre.
bank.en: The airport is thirty kilometres from downtown.

bank.fr: Le trajet dure environ quarante minutes.
bank.en: The trip takes about forty minutes.
bank.cue: Durer gives how long it takes.

bank.fr: Le taxi met vingt minutes pour arriver.
bank.en: The taxi takes twenty minutes to arrive.

bank.fr: Nous allons prendre le train plutôt que la voiture.
bank.en: We're going to take the train rather than the car.

bank.fr: Le train est plus rapide que l'autobus.
bank.en: The train is faster than the bus.
bank.cue: Plus rapide que means faster than.

bank.fr: Le vélo est le moyen le plus pratique ici.
bank.en: The bicycle is the most practical option here.
bank.cue: Le plus pratique means the most practical.

bank.fr: La piste cyclable longe la rivière.
bank.en: The bike path runs alongside the river.
bank.prompt: Hear what the bike path follows.

bank.fr: Roulez prudemment dans cette rue.
bank.en: Ride carefully on this street.
bank.prompt: Give a safety instruction to a cyclist.

bank.fr: Le trottoir est fermé pour des travaux.
bank.en: The sidewalk is closed for construction.
bank.prompt: Understand why the sidewalk is blocked.

bank.fr: Utilisez le trottoir de l'autre côté.
bank.en: Use the sidewalk on the other side.
bank.cue: De l'autre côté means on the other side.

bank.fr: Le pont est fermé aux piétons.
bank.en: The bridge is closed to pedestrians.

bank.fr: Traversez le pont par la passerelle.
bank.en: Cross the bridge using the footbridge.

bank.fr: La passerelle est éclairée la nuit.
bank.en: The footbridge is lit at night.
bank.prompt: Understand when the bridge is lit.

bank.fr: La route est glissante après la pluie.
bank.en: The road is slippery after rain.

bank.fr: Marchez avec prudence près de la chaussée.
bank.en: Walk carefully near the roadway.

bank.fr: La rue est à sens unique.
bank.en: The street is one-way.

bank.fr: Vous ne pouvez pas tourner à gauche ici.
bank.en: You can't turn left here.

bank.fr: Prenez la prochaine rue à droite.
bank.en: Take the next street on the right.
bank.cue: Prochaine rue is the next street.

bank.fr: Le numéro vingt se trouve après la boulangerie.
bank.en: Number 20 is after the bakery.
bank.cue: Après la boulangerie is the landmark.

bank.fr: Le bâtiment se trouve entre la banque et l'école.
bank.en: The building is between the bank and the school.

bank.fr: La rue du Parc est parallèle à la rivière.
bank.en: Park Street is parallel to the river.

bank.fr: Le chemin descend vers le lac.
bank.en: The path goes down toward the lake.

bank.fr: Montez les escaliers jusqu'au deuxième étage.
bank.en: Go up the stairs to the second floor.

bank.fr: L'ascenseur est au bout du couloir.
bank.en: The elevator is at the end of the corridor.
bank.cue: Au bout du means at the end of.

bank.fr: Prenez l'escalier à gauche de l'accueil.
bank.en: Take the stairs to the left of reception.
bank.prompt: Direct a visitor to the stairs.
bank.cue: À gauche de gives relative position.

bank.fr: La salle d'attente est au premier étage.
bank.en: The waiting room is on the first floor.

bank.fr: L'entrée principale donne sur la place.
bank.en: The main entrance opens onto the square.

bank.fr: L'entrée accessible est derrière le bâtiment.
bank.en: The accessible entrance is behind the building.
bank.cue: Accessible is specified by its location.

bank.fr: L'ascenseur permet d'éviter les marches.
bank.en: The elevator makes it possible to avoid the steps.

bank.fr: Y a-t-il une rampe près de la porte ?
bank.en: Is there a ramp near the door?

bank.fr: La rampe est du côté de la rue.
bank.en: The ramp is on the street side.
bank.prompt: Hear which side has the ramp.
bank.cue: Du côté de means on the side of.

bank.fr: Je suis descendu à la mauvaise station.
bank.en: I got off at the wrong station.

bank.fr: Est-ce que je peux reprendre le même train ?
bank.en: Can I take the same train again?
bank.prompt: Ask how to recover from a missed stop.

bank.fr: Reprenez la ligne en direction du centre.
bank.en: Take the line again toward downtown.

bank.fr: Vous devez changer à la station suivante.
bank.en: You have to transfer at the next station.

bank.fr: La correspondance est indiquée sur les panneaux.
bank.en: The transfer is shown on the signs.
bank.prompt: Hear where to find transfer information.

bank.fr: Suivez les indications pour la ligne bleue.
bank.en: Follow the directions for the blue line.
bank.prompt: Tell someone how to find a line.

bank.fr: La ligne bleue dessert l'université.
bank.en: The blue line serves the university.
bank.prompt: Understand which destination the line serves.

bank.fr: Nous arrivons au centre dans dix minutes.
bank.en: We'll arrive downtown in ten minutes.
bank.cue: Dans dix minutes is in ten minutes.

bank.fr: Merci, je connais le chemin maintenant.
bank.en: Thanks, I know the way now.

activities.title: A platform change
activities.prompt: Listen to the connected announcement. Which platform should passengers use for the train to Québec?
activities.script: Attention, le train de dix heures vingt pour Québec partira du quai six au lieu du quai quatre. Pour rejoindre le quai six, prenez l'escalier à gauche et suivez les panneaux bleus. Le départ reste à dix heures vingt.
activities.explanation: The platform changes from 4 to 6, but the announcement says the 10:20 departure time remains the same.

activities.title: Ask for walking directions
activities.prompt: Listen to the full exchange. What landmark should the visitor pass before turning?
activities.script: — Excusez-moi, comment aller à la bibliothèque ? — Continuez tout droit jusqu'au feu. Traversez la rue et passez devant la banque. La bibliothèque est juste après le petit parc, à droite. — Merci, je traverse et je tourne après le parc ? — Exactement.
activities.explanation: The directions say to pass in front of the bank, then find the library just after the park.

activities.title: Read a service notice
activities.prompt: Read the notice and choose the alternative for passengers travelling to the airport.
activities.passage: Travaux sur la ligne bleue samedi. Aucun métro entre Centre et Aéroport de 9 h à 16 h. Prenez la navette gratuite depuis l'arrêt Centre, rue du Marché. Départs toutes les quinze minutes.
options: Use the free shuttle from Centre stop
Take the red line from the airport
Wait for the blue metro at Centre
Walk from the Market Street stop to the airport
activities.explanation: The notice directs airport passengers to the free shuttle at the Centre stop on rue du Marché.

activities.title: Follow a walking route
activities.prompt: Read the route and identify what is directly opposite the library.
activities.passage: Depuis la station, prenez la sortie B. Marchez deux rues vers le nord, puis tournez à droite après le pont. La bibliothèque est en face du parc; l'entrée principale se trouve à côté du café.
activities.explanation: The library is opposite the park; the café is next to its main entrance.

activities.title: Explain a route and handle a follow-up
activities.prompt: Give a visitor directions from a transit stop to a familiar public place. Use at least three steps and two landmarks. Then answer a follow-up such as “Is it far?” or “Which exit should I take?” Speak for about 45 seconds.
activities.model: Sortez par la sortie nord. Continuez tout droit jusqu'au feu, puis tournez à gauche après la banque. Traversez la place; le centre est à côté de la bibliothèque. C'est à environ cinq minutes à pied. Prenez l'entrée principale, en face de l'arrêt.
rubric: The route has a clear sequence and useful landmarks.
Prepositions and direction words make the route unambiguous.
The follow-up answer adds a relevant distance or exit detail.

activities.title: Write a transit update
activities.prompt: Write a 55–75-word message to a friend explaining that a bus or train route is disrupted. State what changed, give the alternative route or service, include an estimated time, and suggest a meeting point.
activities.model: Salut Marc, la ligne verte est interrompue entre le marché et le centre jusqu'à midi. Prends la navette gratuite à l'arrêt du musée; elle passe toutes les quinze minutes. Le trajet prend environ vingt minutes. On peut se retrouver devant la gare vers 13 h ? Envoie-moi un message quand tu arrives, je t'attendrai près de l'entrée principale. À bientôt !
rubric: The message explains the disruption and its time period.
The alternative route and estimated duration are usable.
It suggests a clear meeting place/time and sounds natural for a friend.
